repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Reach 是面向 AI Agent 的开源 CLI 工具，一键赋予全网阅读与搜索能力。它零 API 费用，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，有效解决网页访问限制、平台封锁与付费 API 痛点。基于 Python，跨平台部署，显著降低 AI 与互联网交互门槛。
repos.summary_en: Agent Reach is an open-source CLI tool for AI agents, enabling one-click internet reading and searching. With zero API fees, it supports Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu, addressing web access limits, platform blocks, and paid API issues. Python-based and cross-platform, it significantly lowers the barrier for AI-web interaction.

repos.description: Best and simplest tool for website change detection, web page monitoring, and website change alerts. Perfect for tracking content changes, price drops, restock alerts, and website defacement monitoring—all for free or enjoy our SaaS plan!
repos.summary_zh: changedetection.io 是极简高效的网站变更监控工具，实时追踪价格、库存与内容变动。它融合大模型AI实现智能去噪与自然摘要，支持可视化选择与多渠道通知，助您消除监控噪音，实现精准即时告警。
repos.summary_en: changedetection.io is a minimalist, highly efficient tool for real-time website change monitoring, ideal for tracking prices, stock levels, and content edits. It uniquely integrates large language models to perform smart noise filtering and generate natural language summaries. With visual selectors, multi-channel alerts, and self-hosting capabilities, it provides precise, zero-noise notifications for critical web changes.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目原为哔哩哔哩视频下载工具，核心价值在于通过逆向工程实现非公开接口访问突破与内容抓取。应用场景包括下载视频、番剧及付费内容，技术亮点涉及绕过认证体系与反爬机制。但因侵权指控已停止维护。
repos.summary_en: This project was a Bilibili video download tool, with core value in achieving non-public interface access breakthrough and content scraping through reverse engineering. Applications include downloading videos, anime, and paid content, featuring bypass of authentication and anti-crawler mechanisms. However, it has ceased maintenance due to infringement allegations.

repos.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
repos.summary_zh: 基于JavaScript的网盘文件直链获取工具，支持百度、阿里、夸克等八大主流网盘。通过浏览器插件脚本一键解析真实下载地址，突破页面限制，显著提升用户的下载效率与体验。
repos.summary_en: LinkSwift is a versatile, JavaScript-based cloud storage utility designed to extract direct download links from eight major network drives, including Baidu, Aliyun, and Quark. Leveraging advanced browser scripting, the tool automates the parsing of genuine download addresses, effectively bypassing page redirects and standard speed limits. By simplifying the link resolution process, it significantly enhances download efficiency, serving as a powerful automation tool for users who require rapid and seamless cloud resource retrieval on a daily basis, helping to streamline personal workflows.

repos.description: 🚀 抖音、TikTok 数据采集与无水印视频下载 API，自托管，支持 MCP 调用与 Docker 一键部署。| Self-hosted TikTok & Douyin scraper and no-watermark video downloader — async REST API, MCP server, CLI and web console for posts, profiles, comments and playlists. Self-healing identity pool, PostgreSQL archive, one docker compose up.
repos.summary_zh: 自托管的抖音与TikTok数据采集及无水印下载API，支持Docker一键部署、REST API与MCP。集成自愈身份池与PostgreSQL存档，提供CLI和Web控制台，适用于高效抓取与内容归档。
repos.summary_en: This self-hosted, open-source solution provides a powerful API for scraping Douyin and TikTok, delivering clean, watermark-free video and image downloads directly from platform sources. Easily deployable via Docker Compose, it features an async REST API, MCP integration, CLI, and an intuitive web console. Leveraging a self-healing identity pool and robust PostgreSQL archiving, it supports comprehensive data extraction for posts, profiles, comments, and search queries, ideal for developers seeking reliable, large-scale social media data collection and automated workflow integration.

repos.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader是抖音/TikTok下载与数据采集工具，支持高清视频、图集、直播流下载，具备批量采集、多账号管理、数据持久化及Web UI交互。基于Python开发，支持Docker部署，提供代理、多线程、断点续传等功能，适用于内容存档与数据分析。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a TikTok/Douyin downloading and data collection tool, supporting HD videos, image albums, and live stream capture. It features batch collection, multi-account management, data persistence, and Web UI interaction. Built with Python and Docker, it offers proxy support, multi-threading, and resumable downloads for content archiving and data analysis.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供全球免费代理IP列表，包含HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4和SOCKS5协议，每5分钟更新一次。支持JSON、TXT、CSV格式下载，并提供NPM模块和API接口，适用于爬虫、匿名访问和网络测试等场景。
repos.summary_en: Provides a highly reliable, frequently updated list of free HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies from over 140 countries. Updated every 5 minutes, it offers data in JSON, TXT, and CSV formats, along with an NPM module and rotating proxy API for seamless integration into scraping and automation workflows.

repos.description: lxmusic(洛雪音乐)全网最新最全音源
repos.summary_zh: lxmusic（洛雪音乐）项目是一个开源音源分享平台，专门为 LX Music 桌面播放器提供全网最新最全的音乐音源。核心价值在于简化用户获取音乐资源的流程，支持正版音乐发展。应用场景包括音乐爱好者配置播放器、开发者集成音源。技术亮点涉及音源的自动化抓取、更新维护以及社区协作，确保音源的时效性和全面性。
repos.summary_en: The lxmusic project is an open-source platform sharing comprehensive and latest music sources for the LX Music desktop player. Core value is to streamline user access to music resources and promote licensed music consumption. Applications include music enthusiasts configuring players and developers integrating sources. Technical highlights feature automated source crawling, update maintenance, and community collaboration for timeliness and completeness.

repos.summary_zh: BiliTools是针对哔哩哔哩平台的自动化辅助工具，专注于视频解析与数据处理。因收到平台委托律所的法律函件，指控构成侵权及不正当竞争，项目已于2026年7月正式停止维护与所有版本发布。
repos.summary_en: BiliTools serves as an automated utility tailored for the Bilibili platform, focusing on video parsing and data processing. Following a legal letter from a commissioned law firm accusing it of infringement and unfair competition, the project officially ceased maintenance, updates, and all version releases in July 2026, marking a significant loss for the community.

repos.description: 🔥 今日热榜 API，一个聚合热门数据的 API 接口，支持 RSS 模式 及 Vercel 部署 | 前端页面：https://github.com/imsyy/DailyHot
repos.summary_zh: 聚合多平台热点数据的轻量级API接口，支持JSON与RSS格式，提供哔哩哔哩、微博、知乎等数十条热榜数据。响应迅速，部署简便，适用于数据抓取、热点追踪及个性化RSS订阅服务。
repos.summary_en: An aggregated hot trends API supporting JSON and RSS formats, pulling real-time data from major platforms like Bilibili, Weibo, Zhihu, and Douyin. Lightweight, fast, and easily deployable on Vercel, perfect for developers building custom feeds or tracking viral topics.

repos.description: 自动抓取合并互联网上的公开节点。
repos.summary_zh: 自动抓取合并全网公开代理节点，生成安全的 Clash Meta 订阅。集成智能分流、恶意网站拦截与多 CDN 镜像，提供高效安全的网络访问方案，并附带严谨的隐私与劳动合规声明。
repos.summary_en: Automatically fetches and merges public proxy nodes to generate secure Clash Meta subscriptions. Features smart routing, malicious site blocking, multi-CDN mirrors, and strong compliance stances for safe and efficient internet access.

repos.description: v2ray、clash免费节点爬虫，自动更新
repos.summary_zh: FreeNodes 是一个 AI 驱动的爬虫工具，专用于自动抓取 v2ray 和 Clash 的免费节点。它每日自动运行，从多个网站收集节点并生成 txt 和 yaml 格式的订阅列表，适用于学习交流。技术亮点包括 AI 集成和自动化更新机制，提升节点获取效率。
repos.summary_en: FreeNodes is an AI-powered crawler tool designed to automatically scrape free nodes for v2ray and Clash. It runs daily to collect nodes from multiple sources and generate subscription lists in txt and yaml formats, intended for educational use. Key features include AI integration and automated updates for efficient node acquisition.

repos.summary_zh: 个人私有视频站，支持多网盘接入与低带宽302播放。集成短视频沉浸模式、自定义爬虫、Telegram机器人及一次性分享，助力个人轻松构建高效、私密的专属多媒体播放与管理平台。
repos.summary_en: This is a powerful personal private video website featuring multi-cloud drive integration and low-bandwidth 302 redirect playback. It integrates a TikTok-style short video swipe mode, custom spider scripts, Telegram bot connectivity, and one-time share links, helping individuals easily build a highly efficient and private media library.

repos.description: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）
repos.summary_zh: WebMonitor 是一款实时网页变更监控工具，支持动态抓取与灵活的数据提取。它集成邮件、微信、Telegram 等多通道通知，提供可视化界面与规则配置，助力高效实现网页信息自动化监控与告警。
repos.summary_en: WebMonitor is a real-time web page change monitoring tool that supports dynamic scraping and flexible data extraction. It integrates multi-channel notifications like email, WeChat, and Telegram, providing a visual UI for easy configuration and automated web info surveillance.

repos.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。
repos.summary_zh: RSSPush 是一款基于 Docker 的 Web 应用，实时监控 RSS 源内容变化，并自动将最新消息推送到微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道。支持 HTTP 代理、关键词过滤、自动翻译等功能，可结合 RSSHub 使用，适用于个人和团队的信息自动化推送场景。
repos.summary_en: RSSPush is a Docker-based web application that monitors RSS feed changes in real-time and automatically pushes the latest content to dozens of messaging channels such as WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. It supports HTTP proxies, keyword filtering, auto-translation, and can integrate with RSSHub, making it ideal for automated information pushing for individuals and teams.

repos.description: ⭐️ A proxy scraper made using Protractor | Proxy list Updates every three hour 🔥
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于Protractor的代理爬虫工具，自动爬取代理信息并每3小时更新。支持TXT、JSON、CSV等多种格式下载，并按SOCKS5、SOCKS4、HTTP类型分类。适用于网络爬虫和匿名访问场景，技术亮点包括浏览器自动化、定期更新及代理测试功能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a proxy scraper built with Protractor that automatically crawls proxy information and updates every 3 hours. It supports downloading proxy lists in multiple formats (TXT, JSON, CSV, etc.) and categorizes by type (SOCKS5, SOCKS4, HTTP). Suitable for web scraping and anonymous browsing, key features include browser automation, regular updates, and proxy testing.

repos.summary_zh: 一款功能完善的推特媒体批量下载器，支持多博主管理、智能去重、日期范围过滤及代理配置，旨在实现高效、自动化的社交媒体资源抓取与备份。
repos.summary_en: An efficient Twitter media downloader designed for batch downloading images and videos from multiple bloggers. It features smart deduplication, customizable date filters, proxy support, and flexible path configuration, ensuring automated and reliable social media resource archiving.

repos.summary_zh: 海阔小程序离线数据源采集工具，自动抓取视频数据并生成JSON、M3U等离线播放列表。支持缓存去重、微信推送及GitHub Actions定时自动化采集，适用于构建个人直播源与视频聚合服务。
repos.summary_en: An open-source, automated tool designed to scrape video data from the Haiku mini-program, generating offline JSON, TXT, and M3U playlist files. It features robust caching, slider captcha handling, WeChat push notifications, and scheduled execution via GitHub Actions for fully automated data aggregation.
